# CVision

> [CVision](https://www.cvisionapp.com) is an AI-powered CV and resume analyzer and ATS checker. Upload a CV to get an instant ATS compatibility score, keyword-gap analysis, section-by-section feedback, AI rewrite suggestions, and matching career paths. It also matches a CV against a specific job description and generates tailored cover letters. Fully online and self-serve, available worldwide. Founded by Fatih Çatalçam.

## Product

- [Home](https://www.cvisionapp.com) — what CVision does, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Try it free (no signup)](https://www.cvisionapp.com/try) — upload a CV and get an ATS score plus one improvement suggestion without creating an account.
- [About](https://www.cvisionapp.com/about) — the product and the founder.
- [How ATS works](https://www.cvisionapp.com/how-ats-works) — guide to how Applicant Tracking Systems read, parse, and rank resumes, what an ATS score measures, and how to pass automated screening.

## Services and pricing

CVision is credit-based. There is no subscription and no free trial to cancel:
you buy credits once and spend them as you need them.

- Free to start — a new account is granted 3 credits, which is exactly one full
  Pro analysis. While the balance stays low it earns 2 more credits every week,
  so the product stays usable without paying.
- What things cost, in credits: Normal analysis 1; Pro analysis 3 (the analysis
  plus unlocking its full report); job-description matching 2; AI cover letter
  2; AI bullet-point rewrite 1.
- Extra credits are sold in one-off packs, billed via
  [Lemon Squeezy](https://www.lemonsqueezy.com) as merchant of record. Pack
  sizes and current prices are listed on
  [the pricing page](https://www.cvisionapp.com/pricing) — deliberately not
  duplicated here, because a price copied into a static file is a price that
  goes stale.

### What the credits buy

- Normal analysis: ATS compatibility score, keyword and completeness analysis,
  section-by-section detection, and career-path matches.
- Pro analysis: everything above plus the full AI suggestion pack, AI
  bullet-point rewriting, and the complete AI summary report.
- Job-description (JD) matching: compare a CV against a specific job posting for
  a match score, missing keywords, and a gap analysis.
- AI cover-letter generation: a tailored cover letter from a CV and a job
  description.

## Key facts

- AI analysis powered by large language models (OpenAI GPT).
- Accepts PDF and TXT resume uploads, up to 5MB.
- ATS compatibility scoring plus sub-scores for keywords, completeness, and experience.
- Interface languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, German, and French.
- Works in every country; nothing to install, everything runs in the browser.
